task: Rework the in-repo Keycloak sync job so it reconciles users and memberships through the /v1/idp-sync/ management API instead of the database, as a self-contained platform-import-free job (EPMCDME-16897).

key_reasoning.reason: Job-local settings, copied Keycloak client, new platform HTTP client with token flow, rewritten reconcile/coordinator, entrypoint, plus self-contained packaging (manifest, Dockerfile context) and Helm CronJob. Read half is reusable, so no new subsystem beyond the job itself; stays L, not XL.

Closest pattern is the existing coordinator read logic and KeycloakClient, which does not cover the new security-sensitive parts: service-account token acquisition for the management API (claim mapping untraced), a second Secret, last-admin 409 handling, and 60,000-user scale (about 600 list calls each side within the schedule). No precedent for a platform-free sub-project in the repo. Existing FakeKeycloak/error-path tests cover the defensive test pattern, so no extra bump. Calibrated against sibling EPMCDME-16895 (L 21).

About 7 modified (coordinator, entrypoint, Dockerfile.sync, sync-cronjob.yaml, values.yaml, config.py KEYCLOAK_SYNC_*, ops doc) and about 6-8 new (own manifest, settings, Keycloak client copy, platform API client, tests/fakes) across several directories; tests are largely discarded and rewritten. Sits in L (8-10 modified / 2-4 new at the low end, trending toward XL), scored L.

Job service logic, two external integrations (Keycloak and the platform management API), and infrastructure (image, CronJob, values). Persistence layer is removed, not changed, and no UI, so L rather than XL.
